en.headline: Strong Monsoon Signal remains in force under continued easterly winds
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory maintained the signal into Thursday morning, warning of strong easterly winds with occasional gale-force gusts and rough seas while monitoring a low-pressure area near Hainan.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Strong Monsoon Signal remained in force early on Thursday, with strong easterly winds expected to continue and gusts occasionally reaching gale force.

The signal was first issued on the evening of 18 August and has been kept active through subsequent updates. Members of the public not well sheltered from the east were advised to take precautions against strong gusty winds, and small-craft owners were reminded to secure their boats.

The Observatory continued to monitor an area of low pressure over the northern South China Sea that was moving westwards towards Hainan Island. It had not yet developed into a tropical cyclone, and the public was urged to stay alert to the latest weather information.

zh.headline: 強烈季候風信號繼續生效 偏東強風持續
zh.dek: 天文台周四清晨維持強烈季候風信號，預料吹偏東強風，陣風間中達烈風程度，並繼續監察南海北部低壓區動向。
body: 香港天文台表示，強烈季候風信號周四早上繼續生效，預料本港吹偏東強風，平均風速每小時超過40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。
該信號於8月18日晚上發出後一直維持。天文台提醒，身處當風地方的市民應採取預防措施，防範強勁陣風，小艇艇戶亦應確保船隻安全。
天文台繼續密切監察南海北部一個正穩定西移、靠近海南島一帶的低壓區。該低壓區結構仍較鬆散，尚未發展成熱帶氣旋，市民須留意最新天氣消息。
